reference: Kinoshita, A., Barreto, A., Alves, R., Figueiredo, A.M., Sarkis, J.E.S., Dias, M.L., Baffa, O. (2008) ESR dating of teeth from northeastern Brazilian megafauna. Radiation Measurements 43, 809-812. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.radmeas.2007.11.075

conventions.cosmic: 250 uGy/a stated as 'the cosmic rays dose' (one passage also reads 'cosmic and gamma rays dose ... 250 uGy/yr'; Table 3 shows the sediment gamma separately, so 250 is cosmic only)
conventions.gamma_source: computed by ROSY from soil U/Th/K (NAA and ICP-MS); alpha from soil neglected (~500 um outer layer removed)

samples.provenance: Table 1 (AD, ages), Table 2 (U/Th/K), Table 3 (ROSY dose rates) rows for sample 1; p. 811
samples.notes: Table 3 gives alpha/beta/gamma dose rates (uGy/a) from enamel, dentine and sediment to the enamel, as calculated by ROSY, for each uptake model; the sediment gamma (1496.43 / 1526.62) excludes the cosmic 250 uGy/a. Check: sample 1 EU sum of Table 3 components + 250 = 1909 uGy/a -> 120/1.909 = 62.9 ka (published 63 +- 8). 'CU' = combination uptake (EU dentine, LU enamel). removed_outer_um: text says "an external layer of ~500 um was eliminated" (approximate, side(s) not specified).

samples.provenance: Table 1 (AD, ages), Table 2 (U/Th/K), Table 3 (ROSY dose rates) rows for sample 2; p. 811

completeness: partial: no enamel/dentine thicknesses (only ~500 um outer layer removed), no water content, no 234U/238U measured (initial 1.4 assumed); but full ROSY dose-rate components per source and per model are published
extraction_notes: Site Fazenda Logradouro, Pernambuco (UTM 9094505/0812382), depth 1.8-2.0 m. Stegomastodon waringi teeth. All three tables read twice (separate WebFetch prompts) with identical numbers. Table 2 K in %; enamel/dentine Th and K given as extra keys since ROSY uses them. The paper uses 'AD' (archaeological dose) for De and 'ky' for ka.
